name: Predictive maintenance
description: Enables the Predictive Maintenance operator UI (asset rules, Sparkplug DDATA evaluation, and the dedicated board). Install this adapter to show the menu entry and route; core evaluation APIs may still be used from other surfaces when wired separately.

parkSlug.description: Park slug for demo telemetry scan (also OK in contextJson).

demoTelemetryEnabled.description: When true, poll emits deterministic synthetic OT observations for demo/lab only (see README).

demoMetricProfile.description: Metric bundle preset when metrics[] omitted.

maxAssets.description: Cap ride assets scanned per poll.

scanEntityTypes.description: Entity types for park_assets filter (e.g. ride, attraction).
